findings.label: Rate limiting key evaluated before authentication
findings.issue: Rate limiter key function runs at middleware time before dependencies execute, so owner_id is not yet set in request.state. Falls back to IP address keying, which is per-request-source not per-user.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable for local single-instance deployment. For production multi-instance or multi-user scenarios, use Redis-backed limiter with post-auth user ID extraction.

findings.label: CORS allows credentials with wildcard origins
findings.issue: CORS middleware configured with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True, which violates CORS spec (browsers will reject). Works in practice with TestClient and local dev.
findings.recommendation: Documented as by-design for dev mode. Production deployment must use explicit origin list if credentials are needed.

findings.label: No dedicated rate-limit test coverage
findings.issue: Slowapi integration is present and functional, but no pytest test exercises the 429 path or verifies Retry-After headers.
findings.recommendation: Add a narrow pytest-based rate-limit spot check to CI to verify 429 responses and Retry-After headers on rate-limited endpoints.
